lessons.title: Solar PV Irradiance Transposition (Perez/Hay-Davies Diffuse Sky)
lessons.summary: Compute Plane-of-Array (POA) irradiance from Global Horizontal (GHI) and Direct Normal (DNI) accounting for circumsolar brightening.
checkpoints: Calculate solar zenith and solar elevation angle step-by-step
Validate POA irradiance profile against standard NREL PVWatts

lessons.title: Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) & Inverter Efficiency Mapping
lessons.summary: Simulate perturb-and-observe MPPT dynamics and CEC weighted inverter efficiency curve including clipping losses during peak solar windows.
checkpoints: Quantify annual inverter clipping energy loss

lessons.title: Hybrid PV-BESS Peak Shaving & Self-Consumption Logic
lessons.summary: Simulate commercial & industrial load profiles, charging battery with clipped PV power and discharging during demand charge peak hours.
checkpoints: Achieve 41% reduction in monthly peak demand charges

lessons.title: Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) & Net Present Value Calculator
lessons.summary: Audit-ready financial model factoring in CAPEX, OPEX, degradation, discount rate, inflation, and tax credits (ITC) over 25-year asset life.
checkpoints: Calculate Levelized Cost of Storage (LCOS) and solar LCOE
Perform sensitivity tornado chart on discount rate and battery life
